name: Never Look Back: Yomi, the Underworld
source:
Together with three young men, you are on a rescue mission to save a kidnapped princess from the underworld. Along the way, there are challenges you must face; these challenges will lead you to discover many things, including the love of your life…

[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/82497871710/shall-we-date-never-look-back-release]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
你和三名年轻男子一起踏上营救任务，要从冥界救出被绑架的公主。一路上，你必须面对重重挑战；这些挑战将让你发现许多事情，包括一生的挚爱……

[来源于[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/82497871710/shall-we-date-never-look-back-release]English Otome Games[/url]]
